verified_facts.text: The hotel is in the West End near Washington Circle and the White House.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled in the West End near Washington Circle and the White House, our hotel welcomes you to Washington, D.C.

verified_facts.text: The lobby has handcrafted Windsor-style furniture.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a skylit saltwater pool with a separate hot tub.

verified_facts.text: The 24-hour fitness center in the guest house features two Peloton bikes.

verified_facts.text: The Tea Cellar offers more than 30 rare, single-estate teas from China, Japan, Sri Lanka and the Himalayas.

verified_facts.text: Afternoon tea is available at the Tea Cellar.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tea is ordered by the freshly brewed pot and ranges from $8 to $300. Afternoon tea is available.

verified_facts.text: Blue Duck Tavern crafts rustic dishes from locally sourced seasonal ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Michelin-acclaimed Blue Duck Tavern crafts rustic dishes from locally sourced seasonal ingredients and offers a tasting menu paired with wines from the restaurant's robust cellar.

verified_facts.text: Reservations are strongly encouraged at Blue Duck Tavern.

verified_facts.excerpt: Comfortable seating and Capitol Hill glass-enclosed booths flank the stylish marble and glass bar, providing an intimate lounge experience.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is dog-friendly, with a dog bed, water bowl and treats on arrival.
verified_facts.excerpt: A dog bed, water bowl and treats await your arrival, and we donate a portion of our pet fee to the Humane Rescue Alliance.

verified_facts.text: Valet parking is available for one vehicle per room for a nightly fee.
